thag6.14:1.1: Dipādako 'yam asuci duggandho parihīrati nānākuṇapaparipūro vissavanto tato tato. || ||
thag6.14:2.1: migaṃ nilīnaṃ kūṭena baliseneva ambujaṃ vānaraṃ viya lepena bādhayanti puthujjanaṃ || ||
thag6.14:3.1: rūpā saddā rasā gandhā phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā: pañca kāmaguṇā ete itthirūpasmiṃ dissare. || ||
thag6.14:4.1: ye etā upasevanti rattacittā puthujjanā, vaḍḍhenti kaṭasiṃ ghoraṃ ācinanti punabbhavaṃ. || ||
thag6.14:5.1: yo vetā parivajjeti sappasseva padā siro, so 'maṃ visattikaṃ loke sato samativattati. || ||
thag6.14:6.1: kāmesv ādīnavaṃ disvā nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato nissaṭo sabbakāmehi, patto me āsavakkhayo 'ti. || || Sabbakāmo thero. uddānaṃ: Uruveḷakassapo
thag6.14:7.0: ca thero Tekicchakāni ca Mahānāgo ca Kullo ca Māluto Sappadāsako | Kātiyāno ca Migajālo Jento Sumanasavhayo Nhātamuni Brahmadatto Sirimaṇḍo Sabbakāmako. gāthāyo caturāsīti, therā c' ettha catuddasā 'ti.
